title: Sham Singh Repulses Jain Khan and Charat Singh Proposes a New Formation

blocks.text: Sham Singh's contingent drives back Jain Khan and the Malerkotla attackers after a sharp clash around the caravan. Laxmi Narayan's allies and many Gilja Pathans are beaten off, while Sikh leaders such as Karam Singh, Karora Singh, Nahar Singh, and Binda Singh are singled out for their courage in the rescue.

The fighting does not fully settle the danger, because fresh Turks keep appearing from different sides and the pressure on the moving column continues. Sham Singh therefore turns again toward the Malwa direction and calls for a harder, more disciplined response instead of letting the caravan drift in confusion.

At that point Charat Singh proposes that the Khalsa should reorganize their contingents so the caravan can keep moving while selected jathas strike the attackers. The page works as a hinge between the immediate rescue and the broader tactical effort to save the Panth during the Ghallughara march.
